issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'רַב טַבָּחִים' (rav tabbachim) is a title meaning 'chief of the guards' or 'captain of the guard' (a proper military title), not '多屬宰殺者的' ('many belonging to slaughterers'). The Chinese rendering misinterprets the title, changing the meaning of who led the Chaldean forces.
